items.title: Re-vendor LibKa0s v1.71.0 (kit revision 38) from the local tag; record the unrecorded v1.69.0-v1.70.0 span
items.spec: Mechanical re-vendor per the wow-revendor-libka0s convention and OWNER_SCOPE ruling 5 (no interview, no issue filing). (a) Payloads: `libs/LibKa0s/` replaced whole from `../LibKa0s/LibKa0s/` at the LOCAL tag v1.71.0 (`git -C ../LibKa0s archive v1.71.0 LibKa0s testkit` or a checkout of the tag into a temp dir, never the working tree), and `tests/_kit/` replaced whole from the tag's `testkit/` (kit revision 38). Nothing else under libs/ moves. (b) CLAUDE.md provenance line `Bundles [LibKa0s](...) v1.70.0 (MIT).` -> `v1.71.0`, in the SAME commit (tests/test_vendor_sync.lua greps it and diffs both payloads against the tag in the sibling checkout). (c) docs/test-cases.md regenerated under kit 38: the Totals table counts only cases that run, the declared skip (diagnostics contract opt-out case, docs/test-cases.md:1143) moves to a `| Skipped | 1 |` row, and `| **Total** |` equals the README badge 1035 (today 1036 vs 1035/1035, PM-R-09; the inventory header wording is fixed upstream by LK-01 and arrives with the kit). (d) docs/revendor/<date>-v1.71.0/ with 01_DELTA.md (line 1 exactly `Delta: LibKa0s v1.70.0 -> v1.71.0`, base from the CLAUDE.md provenance line, per-file LibStub minors that moved: Env 2, Slash key 20.2, Widgets key with LineChart 3 / Autocomplete 2, Options key with OptionsIdList 4; kit 37 -> 38 pairing; which majors PanelMaster consumes - Core, Env, Media, DebugLog, Slash, Options, Launcher, Lifecycle, Schema, Bus(Catalog); contract changes under unchanged signatures: Slash ParseValue now refuses nan/inf, Env.GetAddOnMetadata no longer reads the bare global), 02_CANDIDATES.md listing every new surface (Kit.secret / Kit.installIssecretvalue, the Widgets fixes) as 'not adopted in this run' with reason, and 05_SUMMARY.md. (e) The consolidated span bundle docs/revendor/<date>-v1.69.0-v1.70.0/ for the two unrecorded re-vendors (commits 4e15691 and f61f2b7, PM-A-11): 01_DELTA.md whose line 1 is exactly `Delta: LibKa0s v1.69.0 -> v1.70.0 (span: v1.69.0 v1.70.0)` with base v1.68.1 in the body (shape copied from docs/revendor/2026-10-01-v1.64.0-v1.65.0/), and 05_SUMMARY.md with one line per tag: carried by the sweep, LineChart/Autocomplete not consumed, nothing adopted. (f) Any red the fresh payload causes (e.g. a test that pinned the old kit Totals or the v1.70.0 Env rung) is fixed in this commit only if it is a mechanical consequence of the copy; anything behavioural is recorded in 05_SUMMARY.md and fixed by the owning PM item. docs/testing.md:242 'kit 36' is NOT touched here (PM-11 makes it defer to the provenance line).

items.spec: options-ui-§12 MUST: settings/Slash.lua Sl:DoResetAll (:36-:47), inside the existing S.BulkBegin('reset','all') bracket and after a successful db:ResetProfile(), restores every sessionOnly row to its default row by row: iterate the schema rows (settings/Schema.lua) whose `sessionOnly` is true or whose path is `state.debugConsole` (both rows at :668-:682), and drive each through its own `set` with its default (settings.locked -> locked: NS.Unlock:SetUnlocked(false), which also drops held unlocks; state.debugConsole -> hidden: NS.DebugLog:Hide()). Rewrite the settings/OptionsSetup.lua:285-:294 comment to describe the sweep (it currently defends the omission, which the rule forbids) and the Sl:DoResetAll doc comment. items.title: Stand-down drops combat-held unlocks so a later combat exit cannot unlock every panel
items.spec: modules/Unlock.lua: a new U:DropPending(reason) clears both `pendingUnlock` and `pendingPanels` (reuse dropAllUnlocks' held-request half, :245-:253, without touching NS.State.unlockedPanels), returns the number dropped, and writes one `[Unlock]` debug line when n > 0 ('dropped %d held unlock(s): %s'). core/LifecycleSetup.lua NS.StandDown (:101-:110) calls `NS.Unlock:DropPending('stood down')` (guarded on NS.Unlock) before unregistering PLAYER_REGEN_ENABLED. While stood down, an unlock request is applied immediately instead of queued: U:SetUnlocked's combat branch is skipped when the addon is down (NS.IsAddonEnabled() false or the latch's down state), because there are no frames to hand the player and no REGEN event to replay it. Correct the core/LifecycleSetup.lua :65-:66 comment ('has nothing to defer while the addon is down') to say stand-down drops anything held. settings/Slash.lua:389 comment re-read for the same claim. U:ForgetPending is unchanged.

items.title: Non-Latin and accented panel names get distinct frame names; duplicate-name check folds UTF-8 case
items.spec: core/Util.lua Util.Slugify (:199-:203): ASCII alphanumerics are kept, runs of ASCII non-alphanumerics still collapse to one `_` (so 'Chat BG' and 'Chat-BG' still give 'Chat_BG' and every existing ASCII frame name is byte-identical), and every byte >= 0x80 is encoded as two upper-case hex digits (e.g. 'Ärger' -> 'C384rger', 'Обзор' -> 'D09ED0B1D0B7D0BED180'), so distinct UTF-8 names give distinct slugs. Encoded runs and ASCII text join without an extra separator; a name that is only ASCII punctuation still falls back to 'Panel'. Applies only where a frame name is derived for a NEW or re-stamped record (R:Create's Util.FrameName and the frameName backfill in R.Sanitize for records that have none); stored rec.frameName values are never rewritten, so existing anchors do not move. Duplicate-name guard independent of the slug: new Util.FoldName(name) = ASCII lower() plus a UTF-8 simple case fold for the Latin-1 Supplement (U+00C0-U+00DE except U+00D7 -> +0x20), Latin Extended-A even/odd pairs (U+0100-U+017F), Greek (U+0391-U+03A9 -> +0x20) and Cyrillic (U+0410-U+042F -> +0x20, U+0400-U+040F -> +0x50); R:FindByName (modules/Registry.lua:373-:381) compares FoldName on both sides, so 'Übersicht' and 'übersicht' are one name. Rewrite the Slugify comment (it relied on ASCII-only lower plus the slug collision). README.md:95-:99 ('anything that is not a letter or number turned into an underscore') gains one sentence: letters outside A-Z are written as hex codes, with an example. Keep modules/Registry.lua < 1000 lines (972 today) and core/Util.lua's functions <= CCN 15 (put the fold table in a local map). Reference PanelMaster#26 in the commit body. 3. Update comments, README paragraph, docs/schema.md / docs/data-flow.md where the slug rule is described, and docs/smoke-tests.md LOC-2/LOC-3 expected results (two distinct frame names; lower-case lookup now matches).

items.title: Panel number fields refuse NaN and infinity, and /pm recover repairs a non-finite position in one run
items.spec: One finite test, Util.IsFinite(n) in core/Util.lua: `type(n) == 'number' and n == n and n ~= math.huge and n ~= -math.huge`. Used in: settings/PanelSchema.lua COERCE.number (:40-:44) -> a non-finite tonumber result returns nil, 'expected a number' (so `/pm panel X set width nan|inf|-inf|1e999` is refused with the existing message); core/Util.lua Util.Clamp (:16-:22) -> a non-finite n falls back to tonumber(fallback) if finite, else lo; modules/Registry.lua freeNumber (:241) -> non-finite returns the template value; R:SetPosition (:811-:822) -> a non-finite x or y is dropped (as a non-number is today). R.RecoveredOffsets / R.IsOffScreen / R:Recover (:897-:930): a record whose x or y is non-finite is recovered to the clamped template offsets (0,0 within range), and IsOffScreen compares with the repaired value so a second /pm recover reports 0 moved (today NaN ~= NaN reports 'moved 1 panel' forever). Width/height non-finite are covered by Clamp. This item does not depend on LK-05 (the library's ParseValue refusal); both guards stand. Registry.lua stays < 1000 lines. Every item that adds or renames cases regenerates docs/test-cases.md (`lua tests/run.lua --list > docs/test-cases.md`) and moves the README.md Tests badge to the new passing count in the SAME commit (docs/testing.md ▸ test-cases.md); after RV-PM the Totals row equals the badge.
